lines.trans: Chairwoman, Mr Chun Yuqiao had acute stomach bleeding, though it is under control now.
The doctors say he still needs to stay in hospital for a few days.
This flare-up was triggered by alcohol.
Chairwoman, it is all my fault; a group of my friends invited me and our boss out for drinks.
They poured me too many drinks and started egging our boss on to drink a glass too.
Then our boss drank a glass in order to block the toast for me.
Understood — until our boss recovers fully, we will not disturb him with office matters.
Take care on your way out, Chairwoman.

words.gram: Meaning: take care on your way out.

lines.trans: Save your thanks for sparing your pride; left to me, I would not have spared you a shred of dignity.
Even you know you went too far this time and never expected it to turn this serious, right?
Want to know what our boss went through last night? Induced vomiting, stomach pumping, IV drips, endoscopy, surgery prep, and a critical-condition notice!

words.gram: Meaning: be on an IV drip.

examples.trans: Good producers observe small details in daily life.

meanings.note: transitive verb meaning to thank someone

examples.text: 不用谢我，你要真想谢我，就好好工作。
examples.trans: No need to thank me; if you really want to thank me, just work hard.

examples.text: 我真不知道该怎么谢你才好。
examples.trans: I really do not know how best to thank you.

meanings.note: Colloquial verb-object qǐhòng ('jeer or crowd-pressure someone').

examples.text: 朋友们在旁边起哄，非让老大也喝一杯。
examples.trans: Friends egged him on from the side to drink a glass.

examples.text: 大家别跟着起哄，听主持人把话说完。
examples.trans: Stop egging them on and let the host finish speaking.

examples.text: 我跟他不一样，我要了一个实习生的名额。
examples.trans: I am different from him; I asked for one intern spot.

examples.text: 这是跟。
examples.trans: Translation.

examples.text: 要注意身体啊！
examples.trans: Take care of your health!

examples.text: 他身体很好。
examples.trans: He is in good health.

examples.text: 我还约了人，你们先回去吧。
examples.trans: I also have an appointment with someone; you two head back first.

examples.text: 这些资料，还有这四百个小时的录像资料。
examples.trans: These files, plus these four hundred hours of video recordings.

examples.trans: I am going right now to notify Brother Fenhong for taping!

examples.trans: Please arrive on time once you get the meeting notice.

examples.text: 不要太着急了，招聘竞争都很激烈。
examples.trans: Do not get too anxious; the hiring competition is very fierce.

examples.trans: Stomach patients should steer clear of alcoholic drinks.

meanings.note: Colloquial noun lǐzi (paired with 面子, 'inner dignity/substance').

examples.text: 依我的意思，连里子我都不想给你留。
examples.trans: Left to me, I would not spare a shred of your pride.

examples.text: 做节目既要有好看的面子，也要有扎实的里子。
examples.trans: A great show needs both outer polish and inner substance.

examples.text: 朋友们在旁边起哄，非让老大也喝一杯。
examples.trans: Friends egged him on, insisting our boss drink a glass too.

examples.text: 雨下得这么大，你非要今晚赶回去吗？
examples.trans: In rain this heavy, must you really rush back tonight?

examples.text: 你不用谢我刚才在会上给你留面子。
examples.trans: Do not thank me for sparing your face in the meeting.

examples.text: 大家都是老同事，说话还是要留点面子。
examples.trans: Among old colleagues, leave everyone a bit of face.
